assets.title: Three-Outlet Closed-Cap Fire Hydrant
assets.description: Original standalone three-outlet fire-hydrant static exterior visual. A broad chamfered base flange supports a stout stepped upright body, faceted domed bonnet and fixed pentagonal top nut. Two opposing smaller side outlet necks and one larger lower front neck each carry a separate thick shouldered closed cap with a fixed polygonal boss. Four small fixed base fastener heads are seated in the flange. Seventeen editable closed meshes have finite actual overlap seats and a connected support path to the flat base flange. Three constant fully opaque solid PBR materials. One original prop, metre scale, Z up, front -Y, base-centre origin. No textures, logos, chain, hose, pipe network, ground, scene, people, animation or reused geometry. Every outlet stays capped. The necks and body are solid visual volumes; no hidden hollow interior or continuous working water passage is modeled or claimed. Static stylized exterior only: no water flow, pressure, fire suppression, operation, installation, pipe or hose compatibility, structural load, manufacturing, fire-code or safety certification. Not real firefighting equipment design or use guidance.
